LOW_CountingHouse_HeadBanker
Rakath Glitterbeard is the dwarven head banker of The Counting House, encountered during Act Three.
“
Yes sir, Stone Lord, sir. Shall we open the account in your name, or the Absolute's? Just step this way to your special deposit box - don't mind the teeth.
„
— Rakath Glitterbeard, exhibiting exemplary customer service

Involvement

Act Three

Main article: Return Rakath's Gold

When the party first enter the lower area of The Counting House vaults, a cinematic conversation triggers, which leads to a combat encounter. If Glitterbeard survives, he reveals that he works for the Guild and that  Nine-Fingers Keene instructed him to lure the  Stone Lord into the vaults and kill him with a mimic. However, the plan has failed, and he asks the party to retrieve the 10,000 stolen gold. The party can pass a dialogue check to convince Rakath that the Guild should pay for half of it.

If looting the high security vaults around the room, Rakath may occasionally rebuke the party, but he never becomes hostile.

If returning Rakath's gold, he rewards the party with the  High Security Vault nº9 Key, which unlocks a vault containing  Elegant Studded Leather. Alternatively, the party can pickpocket the key from him or lockpick the vault itself.

Speak with Dead

Glitterbeard can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Rakath Glitterbeard
      Rakath... Glitterbeard...
  • What did you do here?
    • Rakath Glitterbeard
      Served the bank... served... Nine-Fingers...
  • What was all that with the mimic?
    • Rakath Glitterbeard
      Trap... for... Stone Lord...
  • What did the cult want with all that gold?
    • Rakath Glitterbeard
      Soldiers... for the... Absolute...
  • What can you tell me about the Stone Lord?
    • Rakath Glitterbeard
      Big... bastard... smelled... like shite...
  • How can I open the private vaults?
    • Rakath Glitterbeard
      Key... idiot...
